title: IKEA Desk Lamp
description:
Barely used desk lamp in white. Pickup in Hapjeong.

Bought last year and only used for a few months of remote work. Soft white finish, works with a standard E26 bulb (bulb included). No dents or stains.

Pickup preferred near Hapjeong Station. Can meet evenings or weekends. Cash or transfer fine.

title: Air Fryer 3.5L
description:
Moving sale — works great, includes the original basket.

3.5L capacity, enough for two people. Used lightly; cleaned after every use. Includes the original non-stick basket and a simple recipe booklet.

Available for pickup in Seoul (flexible neighborhood). Message if you need it before the end of the month — packing up to leave Korea.

title: Uniqlo Winter Coat M
description:
Warm padded coat, size M. Smoke-free home.

Black Uniqlo padded coat, men's M. Worn one winter. No holes, zipper works smoothly. From a smoke-free apartment.

Try-on possible in Hongdae area. Happy to meet at a café nearby.

title: Korean Textbooks Set
description:
Level 1–3 textbooks free to a good home. Hongdae area.

Set of beginner Korean textbooks (levels 1–3) with some pencil notes in the margins. Free if you can pick them up this week.

Near Hongik University Station. Message before coming so I can leave them with the building guard if needed.

title: 24" LG Monitor
description:
1080p office monitor. HDMI cable included.

24-inch LG, Full HD, used for coding and video calls. Stand is adjustable; no scratches on the screen. HDMI cable included; power cable included.

Pickup in Seongsu preferred. Can help carry to a nearby station.

title: Yoga Mat + Blocks
description:
Looking for a lightly used yoga mat in Seoul.

Wanted: a clean yoga mat (any decent brand) and ideally a pair of blocks. Prefer something without heavy perfume smell.

Can pick up almost anywhere on the Seoul metro after work. Happy to pay fair secondhand price — message with photos.

title: Cuckoo Rice Cooker
description:
Standard 6-cup cooker. Clean and ready to go.

Cuckoo 6-cup rice cooker with measuring cup and paddle. Works perfectly; interior cleaned thoroughly. Ideal if you cook rice often in a small kitchen.

Pickup in Yeonnam-dong. Evenings best.

title: Folding Bike
description:
City folding bike, good for subway + short rides.

Compact folding bike, recently tuned brakes and tires. Folds to fit in an elevator or subway vestibule. Includes a basic lock.

Meet near Konkuk University Station. Test ride welcome.

title: Wooden Shelf Unit
description:
Free bookshelf if you can haul it from Itaewon.

Solid wood shelf unit, about waist height, three shelves. Free to whoever can carry it out — no elevator in the building, stairs only.

Must pick up this weekend. Message for exact address and timing.

title: Standing Desk Frame
description:
Electric standing desk frame only — top sold separately.

Quiet motor, dual motors, memory presets. Height range suits most desks. Minor scuffs on the feet from office carpet.

Pickup in Gangnam. Bring a car or delivery helper — it's heavy.

title: Nintendo Switch OLED
description:
OLED model with dock, joy-cons, and two games.

Lightly used, screen protector already on. Includes Animal Crossing and Mario Kart. Original box available.

Meet near Jamsil. Transfer preferred.

title: Merrell Hiking Boots 42
description:
Men's EU 42 hiking boots, broken in but solid.

Good tread left, waterproof membrane still works. Used on weekend trails around Seoul.

Pickup in Sadang or can meet on Line 4.

title: Cast Iron Skillet Set
description:
Two Lodge skillets — 8" and 10". Seasoned and ready.

No rust. Great for gas or induction with a plate. Includes silicone handle covers.

Free if you pick up in Mapo this week.

title: English Novel Stack
description:
About 20 English paperbacks — thrillers and lit fic.

Mostly mass-market paperbacks in good shape. Take the whole box or cherry-pick.

Near Konkuk. Message for the list if you care about titles.

title: Adjustable Dumbbells 20kg
description:
Pair of adjustable dumbbells, 2–20kg each.

Home gym sale. Plates click in cleanly. Floor mat not included.

Pickup in Bundang. Car recommended.

title: Wanted: Office Chair
description:
Looking for a decent mesh office chair under ₩80,000.

Prefer lumbar support and working wheels. Doesn't need to be fancy — just not broken.

Can pick up across Seoul on weekends. Send a photo and price.

title: Sony a6400 Body
description:
Mirrorless body only — no lens. Shutter count under 8k.

Includes battery, charger, and strap. Sensor cleaned recently. Perfect as a second body.

Meet in Hongdae. Open to trades for a good 35mm lens.
